title: Constant-parameter product noise operator
statement: Let $\\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set with a probability mass function $\\pi$, and let $\\iota$ be a finite nonempty index set. Suppose $B$ is a basis of real-valued functions on $\\Omega$, indexed by $\\iota$, whose distinguished basis vector is constant $1$ and whose vectors are orthonormal for the inner product weighted by $\\pi$. For any natural number $n$, real parameter $\\rho$, and real-valued function $f$ on $\\Omega^n$, the anisotropic product noise operator with parameter equal to $\\rho$ in every coordinate agrees with the spectral product noise operator with parameter $\\rho$.
